finding: D-MPNN LOMO regression auxiliary on metal-stripped graph, not capacity, is the transfer bottleneck
notes: All numbers MEASURED on disk, this session, RTX PRO 6000 cuda:0
RF Morgan-fingerprint reference on identical protocol: 0.68 (no_synth 0.683 / synth1000 0.643) => transferable signal EXISTS in the representation
0/5460 molecules in metal_lomo.csv contain the metal atom; featurize._strip_metal_atoms guarantees ligand-only graph
root_cause: MultiTaskLoss mixes a pIC50 MSE term with the BCE term on a METAL-STRIPPED graph. Absolute pIC50 level is not identifiable from the encoder input, so the regression term is pure label noise w.r.t. the trunk and corrupts the shared representation the classification head reads. The alpha sweep shows a sharp cliff: 0.0->0.516, 0.2->0.342, 0.5->0.351.

rejected_fixes.C_capacity (hidden 512 depth 4): 0.3535 vs 0.3512 baseline - no effect, capacity is NOT the bottleneck
rejected_fixes.A_metal_embedding: metal one-hot on RF gave 0.674 vs 0.664 - within noise; and the Rh one-hot column is ALL-ZERO in train under LOMO so it is an unseen category. featurize._strip_metal_atoms already guarantees ligand-only graph, so the embedding is the only metal path and it cannot help the HELD-OUT metal.

premise_correction: Brief stated val/test are correlated. MEASURED: across 5 seeds the baseline val/test correlation is -0.727 (ANTI-correlated); under a pure-noise null at n_test=54 the expected correlation is 0.031. val and test were measuring different things, consistent with the val/test distribution mismatch already documented in WassersteinLOMOSplitter.
noise_floor: n_test=54 at pos_rate~0.32 gives a permutation-null AUC sd of 0.086 (p05=0.358, p95=0.639). Deltas smaller than ~0.10 are not resolvable at this n.
recommended_fix: alpha=0.0 (drop the pIC50 regression term) is the single highest-impact change: 0.351/0.356 (baseline) -> 0.516 (seeds 0-4) / 0.563 (seeds 5-9). --per-metal-pic50-center is the partial alternative (0.451/0.453) and is SHIPPED as a flag because it preserves a usable pIC50 head for the paper protocol, but it does not close the gap. NOTE: alpha=0.0 means pic50_pred is untrained, so test_pic50_mae is no longer meaningful and must not be reported.
